subject: Hybrid shelf + usage-ledger drawdown — BrightPad prepay negotiation
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-12 09:02 PDT
Subject: BrightPad — prep: hybrid shelf + ledger drawdown options (post-demo)

Team,

Following yesterday's demo with Samir and Anna at BrightPad, they signaled interest in a 3-year committed relationship but asked for flexibility around annual prepay wallets and an ability to draw across years when demand spikes. They want options that preserve our unit economics while giving them predictability. Key asks:

- Multi-year term (3 years) with annual prepay allocations (they prefer year-by-year invoices).
- Ability to carve a "shelf" of unused prepay credits that can be swept forward within defined limits.
- Quarterly true-ups for overage billing vs wallet drawdown.
- Request for deeper effective discount in year 3 if they commit to a minimum total spend.

I've attached the preliminary wallet model so we can map scenarios. Please review two approaches:

Option 1 — Staircase drawdown: explicit yearly buckets, allowed carryover limited to X%, monthly invoicing with quarterly true-up. Simpler accounting, lower legal complexity.

Option 2 — Hybrid shelf + usage-ledger (recommended): single prepay wallet per year that customers draw from; we maintain a ledger for usage that allows intra-year reallocation and a controlled carry-shelf between years (sweep window). Higher flexibility for customer; we can attach caps and decays to protect revenue.

Numbers to validate: BrightPad signaled approximate consumption profile: Year1 ~40% of total expected usage, Year2 ~35%, Year3 ~25% (rough). We need to propose concrete prepay amounts and tiered discounts that tie to committed totals and provide an incentive for multi-year lock-in.

Please review the attached BRP_wallet_model_v1.xlsx and send suggested discount curves and guardrails by EOD. I'll coordinate a follow-up call with procurement once we have two concrete proposals.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: BRP_wallet_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightpad.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Flores <anna@brightpad.com>, procurement@brightpad.com
Date: 2026-08-12 10:18 PDT
Subject: Re: BrightPad — prep: hybrid shelf + ledger drawdown options (post-demo)

Hannah — thanks for the summary and for the demo. A few clarifications from our side before we see formal options:

1) We like the idea of a hybrid wallet — our product usage is spiky (campaigns) and we need the ability to reallocate between quarters.
2) Carryover cap: we would like a rollover cap but more generous than 10%. Can you show a 25% cap option?
3) True-up cadence: Quarterly works for us. We also want the ability to top-up mid-quarter if usage exceeds forecasts without penalty (just charge against overage rate).
4) Yearly payment preference: we prefer annual invoicing but need a monthly/quarterly usage report tied to the ledger to reconcile.

Can you also include language options for what happens to unused credits at the end of a contract year? Our procurement prefers a 6-month sweep window rather than immediate forfeiture.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Ops | BrightPad Inc.
samir@brightpad.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightpad.com>, Anna Flores <anna@brightpad.com>, procurement@brightpad.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-13 08:34 PDT
Subject: Re: BrightPad — hybrid wallet options & proposed numbers

Samir / Anna — thanks, that's helpful. Attached is a first-pass proposal (BRP_proposal_hybrid_v2.pdf) with two structured options and illustrative numbers. High-level: 

Option A — Hybrid shelf + ledger (recommended):
- Year 1 prepay: $900,000 (invoiced annually)
- Year 2 prepay: $700,000
- Year 3 prepay: $500,000
- Total committed prepay: $2,100,000 over 3 years
- Discount ladder (effective reductions on list rates applied to usage drawn from the wallet): Year1 = 12%, Year2 = 15%, Year3 = 18% (tiered by drawdown cadence; final year discount provided as incentive).
- Carryover (shelf) policy: up to 25% of annual prepay may be carried forward to the next year; unused beyond cap will be eligible for a 6-month sweep window.
- True-ups: quarterly, with ability to top-up mid-quarter at standard overage rate.
- Accounting: we maintain a usage ledger for reporting; invoices show prepay amount, draws, and true-up adjustments.

Option B — Staircase buckets (simpler):
- Yearly isolated buckets: same prepay amounts but carryover limited to 10%; deeper year-discount only if cumulative spend thresholds are met.
- Simpler contract language, slightly better margin for us.

Risks & guardrails proposed by Finance/RevOps:
- Carryover cap must be enforced with ledger monitoring; we propose a soft cap notification at 15% usage remaining and hard cap at 25%.
- Unused credits beyond sweep window convert to a contractual credit that can only be used for Redwood Professional Services or reserved capacity (protects revenue).

Next steps: Laura, can you take Option A and draft the commercial summary page and SOW language? Rishi, finance input on the convert/credit safeguard please — want to avoid creating a large recognition hole. Samir / Anna — if this looks directionally right, we can schedule procurement/legal call next week.

Best,
Hannah
---
Attachment: BRP_proposal_hybrid_v2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
Related link: https://hubspot.example/contacts/BRP-2026-021

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-13 11:09 PDT
Subject: RE: BrightPad — hybrid wallet options & proposed numbers

Quick internal note on guardrails:

- I support Option A for closing probability, but we need hard protections: limit carryover to 25% of annual prepay and require a 6-month sweep window (BrightPad can use credits during that time). After the sweep window, any remaining balance should not be cancellable for cash refunds — instead convert to a one-time credit with 50% face value that can only be applied to reserved capacity or advanced support. That preserves some customer goodwill while protecting ARR recognition.

- Propose a monthly ledger with automated notifications and an escrow-like hold: if ledger shows >15% carryover at quarter close, sales must approve further carry.

- Pricing knobs: if BrightPad insists on a full 3-year escrow with wide carryover we should tighten headline discount by 150–300bps.

I'll draft suggested contract language for the credit conversion and notification window.

-Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Anna Flores <anna@brightpad.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@brightpad.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpad.com
Date: 2026-08-14 09:42 PDT
Subject: Re: BrightPad — hybrid wallet options & proposed numbers

Hannah,

Thank you for the clear options. A few asks from finance/procurement before we book the legal call: 

- The 25% carryover cap is acceptable; we prefer the 6-month sweep window instead of immediate conversion to any lesser-value credits. If a conversion is necessary, we would prefer conversion only after the sweep window and at a 75% value (not 50%).
- Please add explicit language that allows us to opt into a "true rollover" for Year 3 only if cumulative usage meets the committed threshold.
- Also, we require a technical SLO appendix: a 99th%-ile latency SLO for inference endpoints for our reserved pools; this needs to be in the SOW.

If you can update Option A with those two changes (75% post-sweep conversion and Year 3 true-rollover opt-in), we can move to legal review.

Anna Flores
CFO, BrightPad Inc.
anna@brightpad.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, Samir Patel <samir@brightpad.com>, Anna Flores <anna@brightpad.com>, procurement@brightpad.com
Date: 2026-08-15 16:45 PDT
Subject: Final commercial offer for BrightPad — approval to send to Legal

Samir / Anna — thanks for the back-and-forth. We incorporated the feedback:

Final commercial summary (Option A — hybrid shelf + ledger):
- Term: 36 months (annual prepay invoices)
- Prepay schedule: Year1 $900,000; Year2 $700,000; Year3 $500,000 (Total $2.1M)
- Effective discounts: Year1 = 12% off list, Year2 = 15%, Year3 = 18% (anchored to committed drawdown tiers)
- Carryover: up to 25% of annual prepay may be carried forward.
- Sweep window: 6 months after contract year end. Unused credits after sweep may be converted to a service credit at 75% face value (only if BrightPad has not met the Year3 opt-in threshold).
- Year3 "true rollover" opt-in: if cumulative usage at the end of Year2 >= 90% of cumulative committed draw, BrightPad may elect to roll forward remaining Year3 prepay without conversion.
- True-ups: quarterly with ability to top-up mid-quarter at published overage rates.
- SLO appendix: add 99th%-ile latency target for reserved pools; Appendix B to SOW.

Attachments: Final SOW (draft) and commercial summary attached. If internal sign-off from Finance/Legal is OK, we'll route the SOW to DocuSign (link included).

Rishi / Marcus — please confirm you are OK with the 75% conversion and recognition approach so we can lock the language for RevRec. Once confirmed, I'll request Legal to prepare the final DocuSign envelope.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
---
